rules.title: Start with Rookgaard sewers
rules.summary: For very low level rook characters, hunt rats in the Rookgaard sewers before moving to cave content.
reasons: The KB has a conservative rat hunt sourced from Rookgaard dialogue.
cautions: Upgrade to better equipment before deeper caves.

rules.title: Prepare for Troll Cave
rules.summary: At mid rookie levels, Troll Cave is a reasonable next step if the character carries a rope and basic supplies.
reasons: Fits a character moving beyond rats.
The KB flags rope and underground caution for cave content.
cautions: Do not enter cave areas without a rope.

rules.title: Talk to The Oracle
rules.summary: At level 8, an eligible rook character should consider choosing a vocation and mainland town through The Oracle.
reasons: The Oracle handles vocation and mainland town selection for eligible rook characters.
The decision is important and should remain player-confirmed.
cautions: This is guidance only; Copilot will not choose vocation or town for the player.

rules.title: Try rotworms carefully
rules.summary: For level 8+ characters asking for hunting progression, rotworms are a cautious step after rats and trolls if supplies are ready.
reasons: The KB lists rotworms as a next-step underground hunt.
The level range matches early post-rook progression questions.

rules.title: Buy basic supplies first
rules.summary: Before underground hunts, get a rope, shovel, backpack, and light source from a basic equipment merchant such as Al Dee.
reasons: Several starter hunts mention cave or underground risk.
Al Dee sells the basic tools referenced by the KB.
cautions: This recommendation does not inspect inventory yet.
